entries.name: Windborne Bellows

counterPressure.note: It heals its bearer instead of hitting harder. Against anything that dies before the second breath, that trade never pays back.

entries.flavor: It breathes out as gladly as it fires — the same held breath either way, let go.
entries.notes: Name: Windborne (themeAdjectivePools['windswept-spore']) + Bellows (nounPools['armament-primary.plant']). baseType is a nozzle-class muzzle base, wave 1a. Puts a sustain rider on the offense-slot role table assigns it (survivability), which is the class's whole point: fixedAtoms sit in the fixed core, not the drawn pool, so role legality never gates them (unique.exemplar.json's established precedent).

entries.name: Culm of Dispersal

counterPressure.note: The tangle only reaches what is already close. Anything held at range never feels this stem move at all.

entries.flavor: Every joint of this stem already knows where it will break, and lets it happen first.
entries.notes: Name: Culm (nounPools['core-guard.plant']) of Dispersal (conceptPools['windswept-spore']). atom.entangling/atom.sporing belong to the afflict family group, whose roles list does not include core-guard — legal only because a unique's fixed core is not drawn from the role pool (same exemption the exemplar documents).

entries.name: Sheath of Breeze

counterPressure.note: It never carries a flat guard the way a cultivated ward-array piece would; everything it offers renews instead of blocking outright.

entries.flavor: A husk with more air in it than casing. What it keeps out never mattered as much as what it lets through.
entries.notes: Name: Sheath (nounPools['ward-array.plant']) of Breeze (conceptPools['windswept-spore']). Shield family group ('ward-array','armament-secondary','jewel-major') is role-legal for ward-array, so both fixed atoms sit inside the generator's own rules — the only rule bent here is the drawback's reference to a family (atom.warding) the item deliberately omits.

entries.name: Driftgum

counterPressure.note: It only pays out while it is landing hits or watching something die; left idle on the lawn it earns nothing at all.

entries.flavor: Sap that never sets. It travels light because it never intended to stay for the harvest.
entries.notes: Name is the 'fusion' pattern: Drift (noun form of themeAdjectivePools['windswept-spore'] entry 'drifting') + Gum (nounPools['armament-secondary.plant']), one word, two known pool words. econ-graze/sunbloom/midas are all the resource.economy family group, role-legal for armament-secondary via the shared jewel/girdle economy list's fixed-core exemption.

entries.name: Pollen of Scattering

counterPressure.note: The rider only catches when the target is already carrying an air-aligned charge of its own; against anything else it is a plain, unremarkable hit.

entries.flavor: One cloud, thrown at a wind already leaving — sooner or later everything downwind burns the same.
entries.notes: Name: Pollen (nounPools['jewel-major.plant']) of Scattering (conceptPools['windswept-spore']). searing-strike/might/cruelty are all jewel-major-legal on-hit/offense families, drawn straight from the generator's own matrix — no rule bent here beyond the fixed-core count.

entries.name: Buoyant Frond

counterPressure.note: Every drop of the sustain it grants comes from a hit already landed or already taken; it has nothing to offer a manipulator that never touches the fight.

entries.flavor: It survives the way spores do: not by holding on, but by never landing anywhere that could kill it.
entries.notes: Name: Buoyant (themeAdjectivePools['windswept-spore']) + Frond (nounPools['manipulator.plant']). lifesteal/hit-mend are the on-hit family group, role-legal for manipulator; atom.vitality's own roles list omits manipulator, so the variance slot alone leans on the fixed-core exemption.

entries.name: Veering Canopy

counterPressure.note: It never fattens its bearer's own health pool the way a plain cultivated mantle would; every point of budget went to unsettling the other side instead.

entries.flavor: It shades nothing for long. A canopy that will not commit to a patch of ground is a hard thing to plan a siege under.
entries.notes: Name: Veering (themeAdjectivePools['windswept-spore']) + Canopy (nounPools['mantle.plant']). mesmerizing/withering are the afflict family group, whose roles list does not include mantle — legal only through the unique fixed-core exemption, same as entry 002.

entries.name: Untethered Thistledown

counterPressure.note: It only ever helps its bearer avoid or shed a hit; it adds nothing at all to a hit already landed.

entries.flavor: No bud on this crown ever waited to be picked. It was already gone before the bloom finished opening.
entries.notes: Name: Untethered (themeAdjectivePools['windswept-spore']) + Thistledown, an atomic Base noun from uniqueSetSeedPools['windswept-spore'] (whole-token resolution, not a fusion decomposition). atom.evasion and atom.cleansing are both head-guard-legal, drawn straight from the generator's own matrix.
